entries.source: ames' breath emerged from his lips as a frosty white cloud.
entries.translation: 詹姆士呼出的氣息在唇邊化作一團霜白的雲霧。

entries.source: Below him, Seigneur Locklear negotiated scrub brush as he worked his way up the winding mountain path. He cursed expansively as a thorn bush caught in the chinks of his leg guards and he paused to throw his friend an exasperated frown. James smiled, then turned to look out over the snowy peaks that marked the boundary of moredhel territory.
entries.translation: 在他下方，洛克利爾紳爵一面撥開矮叢，一面沿著蜿蜒的山徑往上爬。一叢荊棘勾進他脛甲的縫隙，他破口大罵，停下腳步朝朋友投去一個惱火的皺眉。詹姆士笑了笑，隨即轉身眺望那一片標示著莫瑞德人領地邊界的雪峰。

entries.source: Five hours after arriving at Northwarden, Baron Gabot had called both he and Locklear into his meeting room. While worried about James' story of Nighthawks, he was far more concerned that his magical adviser had not reported back from investigating possible moredhel activity. With a large band of the Dark Brothers approaching his castle, he feared that the old magician might have fallen into enemy hands, and so, reluctantly, he had asked the two Seigneurs to finish Patrus' job.
entries.translation: 抵達北衛城五小時後，加博特男爵把他和洛克利爾一同召進他的議事室。他固然為詹姆士口中夜鷹會的說法感到憂心，卻更擔心他那位法術顧問前去查探可能的莫瑞德人動向後一直沒有回報。眼看一大股黑暗兄弟正逼近他的城堡，他害怕那名老法師已經落入敵手，於是只得不情願地請兩位紳爵去完成派特魯斯未竟的任務。

entries.source: Locklear arrived puffing, his face haloed by mist.
entries.translation: 洛克利爾氣喘吁吁地爬了上來，臉龐籠在一圈霧氣裡。

entries.source: "I thought I was going to have to come down there and carry you up," James said grinning. "You shouldn't have stayed up all night with that serving girl."
entries.translation: 「我還以為得下去把你揹上來呢。」詹姆士咧嘴笑道。「你就不該跟那個侍女廝混一整夜。」

entries.source: "I didn't expect to have to get up at the crack of dawn," Locklear growled, yanking a twig from his chain mail. "Mountain climbing and armor do not mix."
entries.translation: 「我可沒料到得天一亮就爬起來。」洛克利爾沒好氣地咕噥，從鎖子甲上扯下一根小枝。「爬山跟盔甲根本是兩碼子事。」

entries.source: Suddenly, the two Seigneurs wheeled to the sound of a horrible mewling...
entries.translation: 突然，兩位紳爵循著一陣可怕的嗚咽聲猛然轉身……
